info.name: Pet Adoption API
info.description: Generated from the OpenAPI spec. Run "Auth → Login" first — the access token is saved automatically. Postman keeps the refreshToken cookie for "Get a new access token".

item.name: Verify email with the token from the email link

request.description:
🌐 Public

Returns `accessToken` + user profile. Sets the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie.

🌐 Public

Reads the `refreshToken` cookie, rotates it and returns a new `accessToken`. Frontend must call with `credentials: "include"`.

item.name: Reset password with the token from the email link

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `role.create`

`slug` is generated from `name` when omitted.

item.name: Get a role with its permissions

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `role.delete`

System roles and roles assigned to users cannot be deleted.

item.name: Replace the permissions of a role

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `permission.view`

Use `grouped=true` to get them grouped by module for the role editor UI.

🛡️ Permission: `user.view`

Search: firstName, lastName, email, phone

🛡️ Permission: `user.create`

Password is optional — when omitted the user gets an email to set one via "forgot password".

🛡️ Permission: `user.update`

Blocking or deactivating logs the user out from every device.

🔑 Login required

multipart/form-data, field `files` (repeat the field for each image).

🌐 Public (login optional)

Public sees active only. With `pet_type.update` permission inactive ones are included.

item.name: Get a pet type by id or slug

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `pet_type.delete`

Only when no pet / service / adoption listing uses it — otherwise deactivate it.

🔑 Login required

Blocked while the pet has pending / confirmed / in-progress bookings.

🛡️ Permission: `pet.view`

Search: pet name, breed, owner email / name

item.name: Get a pet with its owner

request.description:
🌐 Public (login optional)

Public sees active only. Use `rootOnly=true` for top-level categories.

item.name: Get a category by id or slug

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `service_category.delete`

Blocked while it still has sub-categories or services.

🌐 Public (login optional)

Search: name, short description, category name. Filters: category / categoryId, petType / petTypeId, staffId, isFeatured, minPrice, maxPrice, maxDuration. Public sees active services in active categories only.

🛡️ Permission: `service.create`

Prices are in the base currency (BDT).

item.name: Get a service by id or slug

request.description:
🌐 Public (login optional)

Includes category, pet types and the staff who provide it.

🛡️ Permission: `service.update`

Sending `petTypeIds` / `staffIds` replaces the current list.

body.raw:
{
  "categoryId": 1,
  "name": "Sample name",
  "slug": "sample slug",
  "shortDescription": "sample shortDescription",
  "description": "sample description",
  "price": 1,
  "discountPrice": 1,
  "durationMinutes": 5,
  "icon": "sample icon",
  "image": "https://example.com/image.png",
  "status": "active",
  "isFeatured": true,
  "sortOrder": 1,
  "maxPetsPerBooking": 1,
  "requiresVaccination": true,
  "petTypeIds": [
    1
  ],
  "staffIds": [
    1
  ]
}

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `service.delete`

Blocked while the service has open bookings — deactivate it instead.

item.name: Replace the pet types a service supports
Replace the staff who provide a service
Free time slots for a service on a date

request.description:
🌐 Public

Times are in the business timezone. Each slot lists the staff members free at that time. Considers staff schedules, blocked dates, existing bookings, slot interval and advance-booking settings.

item.name: List staff with their services and schedule
My weekly schedule + upcoming days off (for staff)
Get the weekly schedule of a staff member
Replace the weekly schedule of a staff member

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `staff_schedule.manage`

Days that are not sent are treated as days off. Times are in the business timezone.

item.name: Check a promo code for a service (checkout preview)

request.description:
🔑 Login required

Returns the discount and the final price, or 400 with the reason.

🛡️ Permission: `promotion.create`

`discountValue` is a % for `percentage`, an amount in BDT for `fixed`.

🛡️ Permission: `promotion.update`

Sending `serviceIds` / `categoryIds` replaces the current list.

🛡️ Permission: `promotion.delete`

Only unused promotions can be deleted — deactivate used ones.

🔑 Login required

Pick a free slot from `GET /services/:id/availability`. The least busy free staff member is assigned unless `staffId` is given. Status starts as `pending` and becomes `confirmed` after payment (or when an admin confirms it).

🛡️ Permission: `booking.view`

Search: booking no, customer email / name, pet name. Filters: status, paymentStatus, serviceId, staffId, userId, from, to.

item.name: Booking detail with history and payments

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `booking.update_status`

pending → confirmed | cancelled · confirmed → in_progress | cancelled | no_show · in_progress → completed. Staff without `booking.assign_staff` can only update bookings assigned to them.

🛡️ Permission: `booking.assign_staff`

The new staff member must provide the service and be free at that time.

item.name: Get my booking by id or booking number

request.description:
🔑 Login required

Only pending / confirmed bookings, and at least `booking_cancel_before_hours` (setting) before the start.

🔑 Login required

Pays the remaining due amount of a booking (`bookingId`) or an adoption fee (`adoptionId`) in BDT or USD (converted with the `usd_exchange_rate` setting). Redirect the browser to the returned `gatewayUrl`. Afterwards SSLCommerz sends the user to `CLIENT_URL/payment/success|failed|cancelled?tranId=…&reference=…` (+ `bookingNo` or `applicationNo`).

🌐 Public

Verifies the payment, then redirects to the frontend. Called by SSLCommerz (form POST), not by the frontend.

🌐 Public

Marks the payment failed, then redirects. Called by SSLCommerz (form POST), not by the frontend.

🌐 Public

Marks the payment cancelled, then redirects. Called by SSLCommerz (form POST), not by the frontend.

🌐 Public

Instant payment notification (server-to-server). Called by SSLCommerz (form POST), not by the frontend.

item.name: Record a counter payment (cash / card / mobile banking)

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `payment.create`

For a booking (`bookingId`) or an adoption fee (`adoptionId`). Partial payments are allowed.

🛡️ Permission: `payment.refund`

SSLCommerz payments are refunded through the gateway; counter payments are recorded directly.

🌐 Public (login optional)

Public sees `available` + `pending` (adoption in progress). Logged-in users get `isFavorite`. Filters: petType / petTypeId, gender, size, isVaccinated, isNeutered, isFeatured, minAgeMonths, maxAgeMonths, maxFee.

🛡️ Permission: `adoption_pet.create`

Upload images first (`POST /uploads/images?folder=adoption-pets`) and send their URLs.

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `adoption_pet.delete`

Blocked when it has open applications or an adoption record.

item.name: Put on hold / make available again

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `adoption_pet.update`

`pending` and `adopted` are set by the adoption workflow, not manually.

item.name: Make an image the cover image

request.description:
🔑 Login required

Only `available` pets accept applications; one open application per pet per user.

🛡️ Permission: `adoption_application.view`

Search: application no, pet name, applicant email / name.

🛡️ Permission: `adoption_application.review`

pending → under_review | approved | rejected · under_review → approved | rejected. Approving locks the pet (status `pending`), creates the adoption record and auto-rejects the other open applications.

item.name: Get my application by id or number

request.description:
🔑 Login required

Only pending / under-review applications.

item.name: Update handover date / contract / follow-up date

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `adoption.update`

Requires the adoption fee to be fully paid. Marks the pet as `adopted`.

🛡️ Permission: `adoption.update`

Only when no fee has been paid (refund first). The pet becomes `available` again.

🌐 Public

Sort by `createdAt` or `rating`; filter by `rating`.

🔑 Login required

One review per booking. New reviews are `pending` until a moderator approves them.

🛡️ Permission: `review.moderate`

Recalculates the service's average rating and review count.

🔑 Login required

Pending / rejected reviews only — the edit is sent for moderation again.

item.name: Get an album by id or slug

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `gallery.delete`

Its items are kept and simply become album-less.

🌐 Public (login optional)

Filters: album (slug), albumId, serviceId, mediaType, isFeatured. Public sees active items only.

🛡️ Permission: `gallery.create`

Upload with `POST /uploads/images?folder=gallery`, then send the URLs here.

🛡️ Permission: `blog.delete`

Only when it has no posts.

🌐 Public (login optional)

Public: published posts whose `publishedAt` has passed, in active categories. With `blog.view` drafts and scheduled posts are included.

🛡️ Permission: `blog.create`

`status: published` without `publishedAt` publishes now; a future `publishedAt` schedules it.

Needs the signed `token` from the link in every newsletter email.

item.name: Public settings as a key → value object

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `setting.update`

Send only the keys you change: `{ "values": { "usd_exchange_rate": 121.5, "booking_cancel_before_hours": 12 } }`. Every value is validated; nothing is saved if one is invalid.

🔑 Login required

Filter `unread=true` for the bell dropdown; badge count via `/unread-count`.

item.name: Cards: users, bookings, revenue, adoption, reviews, inbox

request.description:
🛡️ Permission: `dashboard.view`

Payments minus refunds per day or month (business timezone), split into bookings and adoption fees. Missing periods are filled with 0.
